title: Round diamond flex bracelet, triple row
subtitle: Round brilliants are cut to maximize the light returned to the eye. In a single row they do that in sequence — in three rows set side by side, they do it simultaneously across the full width of the wrist. The Three Row was built to hold round brilliants in continuous parallel, each stone facing forward in the Bez Ambar Flex setting so the movement of the wrist becomes part of the piece. Three rows because at this stone count, the width is the point.
